name: Hatori Hisui
source:
3rd year high school student & manga assistant.
Hobby: Drawing backgrounds & buildings.
Kenji's childhood friend and classmate.
She has been his assistant since Kenji's debut. Her dream is to become an architectural designer, and she works as Kenji's assistant to study, but in reality, she just wants to be with Kenji. Her dream is to live with Kenji in a house that she designed. She calls boys her age, including Kenji, "Ome," and is nicknamed "Dictator" in class because she nonchalantly says amazing things and is sarcastic. She sometimes wears a maid uniform to motivate Kenji.
She is also the ace of the art club, but she quickly goes home to work as an assistant, so she becomes a ghost member. She has also published a doujinshi, and the circle name is "Gel-like".
If she were to be the heroine, Kenji would fall into a temporary manga slump.
